data_classes: public OpenHarmony source excerpts and immutable Git identifiers
frozen OHScanner candidate metadata and supplied fact/evidence IDs
frozen prompts, schemas and EvidenceObligation definitions
excluded_data_classes: truth labels and truth manifest identifiers
retention: Provider policy retains information only for the necessary purpose period or legal requirement, then deletes or anonymizes after purpose completion, confirmed deletion/cancellation, or service termination; exact API log duration is not separately stated.
training_use: No model training or other use of provided text without prior consent; A-EXP-01 gives no training consent.
region: PRC for service used in the PRC; policy states information is stored in the PRC.
minimization: Each request contains one fixed review item and only its current-item evidence catalog scope.
